A Bloomberg survey of 19 equity forecasters found the average S&P 500 year-end target slipped just nine points to 7,967 from 7,976 in September, even as the 10-year Treasury yield briefly spiked to well above 5%, the Iran war rattled energy markets, and doubts about AI-spending sustainability triggered a sharp tech selloff late last week。
